buildProposal.decision: Implement the bounded C3 brief-first reading surface, generic explicitly authored meeting copy, and clean clipboard and file export while preserving evidence and immutable generated history.
buildProposal.scope: Build permission under the standing development policy and explicit brief-first implementation and bounded Astra repair authorization. Includes account-qualified brief entry; purpose, facts, hypothesis, questions, close and uncertainty; exact source/passages and unknown-date truth; generic user-authored copy beside original records; existing explicit Save, reopen, version and conflict protections; current-displayed clean copy and Markdown/text download; regression tests, disposable localhost browser QA, independent exact-head technical and bounded subscription visual review, documentation and ordinary PR/CI/merge. No acquisition, product generation, paid fallback, historical/source mutation, lab/private-preview changes, deployment, public ingress, external sends, sharing, approval or customer acceptance. Proposal remains agent-proposed, not Andrew ratification. The code uses existing local Save semantics; this release performs no new operational durable-write effect or product effect.
